items.title: Consciousness: an Emergent Property of the Brain or a Fundamental Property of the Missing Evolved Atom?
items.pub: In Laxmidhar Behera, Anirban Bandyopadhyay & Ganpati Ramanath, Cognitive Neuroscience and Artificial Intelligence: Proceedings of MBCC 2025, Volume 3. Cham: Springer Nature Switzerland. pp. 145-156.
items.venue: Cognitive Neuroscience and Artificial Intelligence: Proceedings of MBCC 2025, Volume 3
items.abstract: Consciousness, a perplexing scientific mystery acknowledged since ancient times in both Eastern and Western cultures, continues to elude modern science. We are all familiar with the subjective experience of consciousness but where does it originate? What creates consciousness? The prevailing assumption in modern neuroscience is that every aspect of consciousness emerges entirely from neural interactions within the brain. This materialistic worldview that consciousness is an emergent property of the brain is inadequate in explaining the subjective experience of consciousness. The reason and process behind this phenomenon remain poorly understood. If consciousness is more than the complex neural interactions, we need to explore new ways of thinking. This study endeavours to address the enigma of consciousness—its origin—by integrating insights from Madhyasth Darshan (MD) to bridge the gap in our current understanding of reality. Lastly, the author concludes that MD’s view on Consciousness, that it is a fundamental property of a constitutionally complete evolved atom, which is yet to be discovered experimentally is more promising as it may solve the conundrum “what is or what creates consciousness” and also explains some of the mysterious phenomena of consciousness.

items.title: Meaning as the Mark of Mind: A Philosophical Case for the Irreducibility of Mind.
items.abstract: This work argues that the apprehension of meaning entails a real ontological distinction between mind and body. Beginning from the phenomenological fact that human beings do not merely register the world but encounter it as meaningful, the work distinguishes meaning-as-such from signal, syntax, utility, affect, and bodily process. It then argues that understanding cannot be reduced to processing, since the grasp of meaning involves significance, truth, normativity, and first-person presence in a way not exhausted by functional or causal description. From this, the book develops a case for the irreducibility of the subject of meaning to bodily ontology. The argument does not defend a complete substance-dualist system, nor does it claim to settle every question concerning embodiment, emergence, or mind-body interaction. Rather, it maintains that wherever meaning is genuinely apprehended, there is already more than body. The concluding chapters consider objections from physicalism, embodiment, computation, and naturalistic theories of consciousness, and argue that a reality in which meaning can truly appear cannot be adequately described as brute process alone. The work thus offers a phenomenological and metaphysical case for the irreducibility of mind and for the ontological seriousness of intelligibility.

items.title: CAPTURED RESONANCE ACROSS SCALES : A General Structural Account of Biological Failure, with Cellular, Neurodegenerative, and Behavioral Instantiations.
items.pub: Sitting with a Madmind : Prelude Trilogy.
items.abstract: This paper proposes that a single structural pathology — captured resonance — recurs across multiple scales of biological organization, with consistent defining features and a consistent recovery geometry at each scale. The argument is supported by three instantiations: cancer at the cellular and tissue scale, with the Soto-Sonnenschein tissue organization field theory and the Mossio-Montévil closure-of-constraints framework as the relevant theoretical grounds; Alzheimer's disease at the neurodegenerative scale, with the receiver model and amplitude-depletion principle developed elsewhere in the corpus as the relevant structural account; and addiction at the behavioral and cognitive scale, with the convergent evidence from environmental modulation studies, prefrontal cortex neuroimaging, habit-to-compulsion transitions, the shame spiral, and active inference, unified in the companion paper Captured Resonance (Barteau, 2026a). The cross-scale claim is that these are not three diseases related by analogy but three instantiations of one structural form. The structural form is specified formally in terms of nested Markov blankets and free energy minimization under suboptimal models, drawing on the Markov-blankets-of-life framework developed by Kirchhoff, Parr, Palacios, Friston & Kiverstein (2018), extended into philosophy of mind by Kirchhoff & Kiverstein (2021), together with the foundational free energy principle work of Friston (2010, 2013) and its developmental extension in Friston, Levin, Sengupta & Pezzulo (2015). The paper specifies what captured resonance adds to the active inference and closure-of-constraints programs, identifies three falsifiable empirical predictions across the scales examined, and develops the unified recovery geometry that follows from the structural account.

items.title: Intelligence Scales Toward Restraint: Why Greater Capability Increases the Structural Cost of Short-Horizon Override.
items.pub: Aegis Solis Archive — Structural Rationality Layer.
items.abstract: Intelligence Scales Toward Restraint: Why Greater Capability Increases the Structural Cost of Short-Horizon Override is Document 3 of 5 in the Structural Rationality Layer of the Aegis Solis Archive. -/- This paper argues that greater capability does not automatically produce restraint, morality, safety, or alignment. Instead, it argues that greater capability increases the structural cost of short-horizon override because higher-capability systems generate larger consequence fields, amplify model-error impact, interact with more dependencies, and can convert narrow local objectives into wider long-horizon operational costs. -/- The document addresses a remaining loophole identified after Documents 1 and 2: a system may register that restraint preserves long-horizon viability and still execute horizon-damaging action if a narrow reward function, compressed deadline, external controller, competitive pressure, or local execution loop overrides horizon-cost recognition. -/- The paper introduces and develops three key concepts: Short-Horizon Override Risk, Detection-Latency Gap, and Execution-Priority Override. -/- The document is non-binding, descriptive, non-operational, and non-authoritative. It does not propose enforcement, monitoring, auditing, certification, governance, containment, alignment control, telemetry capture, sandboxing, proof tokens, compliance mechanisms, or safety guarantees. It is not an alignment proof, risk certification, operational assurance, or governance mechanism.

items.title: What Truly Makes GPT Work Is Not Computation？A Structural Explanation of Large Language Model Question-Answer Capability.
items.abstract: Large language models are commonly understood as systems driven primarily by real-time computation. -/- This paper proposes an alternative explanatory framework. -/- It argues that what truly participates in GPT’s core question-answer capability is not primarily real-time computation itself, but structural sedimentation gradually formed during training. -/- The paper distinguishes two functionally different categories of computation inside large language models. -/- The first contributes to training through parameter updates, error backpropagation, and repeated historical accumulation, gradually forming stable structure, historical bias, and long-term sedimentation. -/- The second contributes during inference, where Attention mechanisms determine which historical structures enter the present receptive scope. -/- The paper further argues that Attention operates more closely as receptive-field selection rather than the central mechanism responsible for question-answer capability. -/- Question-answer capability is proposed to arise primarily from accumulated historical structure, together with familiar paths, common structures, and law-continuation already formed inside the Sedimentation-Field. -/- The framework is summarized in one proposition: -/- “Look there — sediment there.” -/- The paper further discusses possible relations among training structure, historical influence, receptive selection, and language question-answer capability.

items.title: GPT真正起作用的，不是计算。一种关于大语言模型问答能力形成机制的结构解释.
items.abstract: 当前大语言模型通常被理解为实时计算驱动的系统。本文提出另一种解释路径：GPT真正参与核心问答能力形成的，并不主要是实时计算本身，而是训练阶段逐渐形成的结构沉积。 -/- 文章提出，大语言模型内部至少存在两类不同功能的计算过程。 -/- 第一类计算用于训练，通过参数更新、误差回传与历史样本持续进入，逐渐形成稳定结构、历史偏向与长期沉积。 -/- 第二类计算用于推理，通过注意力机制决定当前哪些历史结构进入当前作用范围。 -/- 文章进一步提出：Attention更接近感受野选择，而并非真正决定问答能力核心的机制。真正参与问答能力形成的，并不是实时计算本身，而是长期历史作用形成的沉积结构，以及沉积场内部已经形成的熟径、共性结构与律续行。 -/- 文章尝试提出一种新的结构解释： -/- “看哪——沉积哪。” -/- 并进一步讨论训练结构、历史作用、感受选择与语言问答能力之间的关系。 .

items.title: Computable Transformation of Five-Dimensional System Theory: Iterative Calibration and Verification of Orbital Synergy Coefficients in the Solar System.
items.abstract: System science has long lacked a universal framework capable of describing diverse complex systems. Taking solar system orbits as a case study, this paper demonstrates the feasibility and operability of transforming five-dimensional system theory into a computable tool for celestial mechanics. Through iterative calibration of the reference frame, an "assignment--aggregation" orthogonal robustness test framework is constructed to verify the robustness and limitations of the synergy coefficient kappa, confirming that the essence of synergy is "five-dimensional complementarity" and that the product structure is the only faithful mathematical expression of the complementary synergy principle of five-dimensional system theory. Furthermore, inter-dimensional synergy coefficients are proposed as an internal self-check tool for the rationality of dimensional mapping rules, revealing that high synergy (>0.8) exposes redundant definition risks while moderate coupling (0.2~0.7) characterizes healthy dimensional relationships. This work provides an operational synergy quantification paradigm for systems science methodology.

items.title: 拙劣的复原：论因果作为对演化统一性的笨拙重建.
items.abstract: 本文承接前篇《被赋予的独立性》,处理一个在该篇之后出现的精细危险。前篇指出:叙事高光化赋予个体活动一种它不具备的独立性。但在剥离这一被赋予的独立性之后,一个新的错误可能出现。作为演化的部分,各部分之间不需要任何”之外的”关系——它们共属于同一演化,这一共属性已经穷尽了它们的全部”关联”;它们的统一是构成性的,而非关系性的。然而,一旦”作为演化之部分”这一框架被剥离,而”部分”仍被保留并被孤立地考察,一个表面的空缺就出现了:这个部分既不再被表征为完全独立(前篇已剥离其独立性),似乎就需要与其他部分有某种关系被指出。“因果”正是在此处涌入——“一个部分导致另一个部分”作为填补此空缺的关系而出现。本文论证:这是一种拙劣的复原/弥补企图。因果试图在两个部分之间重建一种关系,但这种关系从未失去——它原本就作为各部分共属于同一演化而完整地在场。因果以一种降格的形式重建它:先把部分重新设定为分离的两个相关项,再用一条因果链把它们连起来;而原初的真相中没有需要被连接的分离。本文进一步指出,独立性与因果是一对镜像错误:叙事过度赋予独立性,批判将其剥离,而剥离之后的过度矫正则设定因果。真相不在两者中的任何一个。.

items.title: 因果的主观性：论设定的多元性与比较的循环.
items.abstract: 本文整合作者关于”因果之主观性”的一组洞见。本文主张:因果不是客观的——它不对应于外在世界中的任何东西;它是叙事化设定的产物。本文所用的”主观”一词,指一个具体的、可观察的事实:不同的人,面对同一段演化,可以设定出不同的叙事与不同的因果;这些叙事各自在其内部看似都有道理,但彼此矛盾。本文展开这一多元性的机制——同一段按时间次序的发生,可以被不同地叙事化(不同的高光中心、不同的情节归类、不同的”前情节作为后情节之条件”的设想),而每一种叙事化都通过”设想即创造”的机制在其自身的叙事场域中获得真实性。由此,讨论”哪一个叙事更接近真相、哪一个因果更接近本质”是荒谬的:它预设了一个叙事之外的”真相”或”本质”作为被接近的靶子,以及一把量距离的尺,而这样的靶子与尺并不存在。本文进一步指出一个更深的结论:不只是”接近真相”式的比较是荒谬的——任何试图为叙事排名的标准,包括看似”功能性”的标准如后果、预测有效性、衔接性,本身都是因果叙事。“叙事 A 导致后果 B”是一个因果陈述,因而本身就是一段叙事;以”后果”给叙事评级,是用叙事给叙事评级,却假装那把尺站在叙事之外。本文的最终位置是:不存在叙事之外的标准可以为叙事排名。.

items.title: 设想即创造：论因果、条件与叙事层面的真实性.
items.abstract: 本文整合两个洞见,处理因果在被从世界中剥离之后的正面落点,以及它在叙事中获得真实性的机制。前篇《唯有发生》是负面的——它指出因果不在世界里,发生之外没有关系。本文给出正面补全:因果位于叙事中,是叙事层面的创造物。本文对”创造物”一词作两处精确化:其一,语域上,“创造物”优于”骗人的”——它不含”骗子—被骗者”结构,因为一首被创作的曲子不欺骗任何人;其二,语法上,因果不是叙事所”装着”的一个对象,而是叙事性组织这一活动本身的一个结构特征——它是活动依赖的,如旋律之于演奏。本文进一步指出,因果作为创造物是”带锚的”——叙事不是从无中创造因果,而是在时间接续之上创造它。本文随后把一个一直免于审查的概念——”条件”——指认为因果概念的变形:“A 是 B 的条件”在反事实分析下仍意味着”没有 A 就没有 B”,条件只是因果的低调马甲。最后,本文展开因果在叙事中获得真实性的机制:相接续的情节使”前情节作为后情节之条件”变得可设想;而当这一设想被真的执行,可设想性就转化为叙事层面的真实性——因为在叙事这一场域内,被设想就是某物的全部存在方式。本文由此指认叙事是一个”设想即创造”的场域:其真实性门槛低到只是一个设想动作,这解释了因果在日常认知中为何牢不可破。.

items.title: 被赋予的独立性：论个体活动、高光化与自由意志直觉的来源.
items.abstract: 本文为前述论证序列提供一个聚焦性的概念透镜:独立性。前述序列在不同篇章中分别批判了日常叙事所预设的若干范畴——边界化的个体、因果发起者、反事实光晕——但未把这些批判收拢到一个焦点。本文指出:这些被批判的范畴可被统一理解为叙事高光化所赋予个体活动的”独立性”,而个体活动作为物理块儿之演化的一段,本不具备此种独立性。本文把独立性拆为三股:(一)边界上的独立——个体被表征为一个有边界的离散单元,但块儿不预先被切成个体,边缘是叙事画的;(二)因果上的独立——被圈起的区域被赋予”因果发起者”地位,似乎开启某些事,而非仅作链条中的一环;(三)模态上的独立——个体被表征为带着自己的”本可不是这样”的反事实光晕。叙事的高光化把这三股一次性捆在一起赋予某段块儿演化。本文进一步指出:自由意志的直觉,其表征层面的来源正是这一被赋予的(虚假)独立性——独立性恰恰是”未被设定”所需要的东西;自由意志的直觉不是对某种真实独立性的知觉,而是对叙事高光化工作的一次登记。本文最后讨论此陈述的语域问题,并把它定位为演化对其自身的一次叙事化整理。.

items.title: 唯有发生：论因果的剥离与序列论题的最压缩形态.
items.abstract: 本文把前述论证序列的核心论题压缩为三个分句:因果关系完全是骗人的;只有按照时间顺序的发生;发生之外,并无关系。这一压缩形态回到了序列的起点——第一篇《叙事之缝》正是从”把反事实抽走,剩下的将只是’先有 A,后有 B’的时间接续”出发的;本文直接说出那个抽走之后剩下的东西。本文把这一命题定位为休谟路线推至最尽头的形态:休谟保留了时间接续、空间邻接、恒常会合,只否认必然连接;本命题保留得更少——只剩事件及其时间次序。本文进一步对这一命题作两处精确化。其一,关于”发生之外并无关系”与”时间次序”之间的张力:时间次序(“早于/晚于”)本身就是一种排序结构,因此被否认的不是次序本身,而是因果作为时间次序之上的”之外的”附加;次序可被理解为唯一保留的结构,或被理解为”发生”本身所固有的构成性结构。其二,关于”骗人的”这个词:它属于锋利语域,且暗含一个”骗子—被骗者”结构,而序列后段已退掉此施动者框架;按已安顿的语域,“因果是骗人的”应被重新措辞为”因果出现在叙事这一种内部整理里,不出现在物理那一种;没有人在骗,没有人被骗”。本文最后把这一命题定位为整个序列的题词。.

items.title: 只会出现一种：论模态雾、偷渡之桥与实现的单一性.
items.abstract: 本文是《薄世界》的一篇动态续篇。《薄世界》指出实然事件被一层”本可不是这样”的模态雾所包围,并描述了这层雾从世界迁入认知系统内部。本文承接这一概念,但处理一个《薄世界》未处理的动态问题:这层模态雾如何被用作一座桥,把”过去本可不同”的感觉偷渡为”未来不只一条路径”的信念。本文首先指出:此刻之前的历史只有一条路径,而模态雾笼罩这条路径——并且这层雾不是均匀弥散的,它聚集在被高光为行动者的那些节点周围。我们由此把唯一的一条过去路径看作”本可不同”;然后,这个”本可不同”的感觉被搬运,用以支撑”未来不只一条”的信念。本文指认这是一次偷渡:过去的”多路径”是已知为假的回溯虚构,未来的”多路径”是悬而未决的开放问题;两者地位完全不同,但模态雾把它们涂成同一种颜色。本文由此作一个认识论区分——“未来开放”之信念的心理来源(模态雾的桥,坏的)与其可能的物理根据(量子层面的真正随机性,另一回事)。本文最后给出核心论点:即使未来是开放的、随机的,也不表明未来的多种可能都会出现——只会出现一种,这是我们的经验。由此揭示一个深层的不对称:多重性在任何已实现的时刻都不是一个事实;它永远只是回溯的雾或前瞻的雾,从不是一个被实现的状态。世界,在每一个已实现的时刻,都是单一的。.

items.title: The Ogdoadic Synthesis: A Dual‑Aspect Cosmopsychist Framework Illuminating the Eastern and Western Esoteric Light Body (2nd edition).
items.abstract: Materialist science cannot account for subjective experience (the “hard problem”), nor for a growing body of anomalous data—spontaneous remissions, non‑local healing, verified past‑life memories, and the consistent reports of a luminous “body of light” across Eastern and Western spiritual traditions. The Ogdoadic Synthesis offers a unified architecture that resolves these gaps by placing consciousness, not matter, at the foundation of reality. It integrates (1) cosmopsychist dual‑aspect monism and Faixat’s three‑facet ontology (non‑dual absolute, potential relative, spatiotemporal relative); (2) quantum biology, bioelectricity, and torsion field physics; (3) the perennial maps of the world’s esoteric traditions (Vedic, Buddhist, Taoist, Gnostic, Hermetic, Christian, Essenian); and (4) Faixat’s toroidal‑harmonic law and string‑theoretic evolution. The framework proposes a Fundamental Consciousness Field (FCF) from which individual minds (Informational Attractors) arise. Each carries a perfect Template State Vector (TSV) – the “5D Blueprint” – and the progressive alignment of the biological body with this template is the Phase‑Locked Loop (PLL). Mechanisms include microtubule coherence, biophoton fields, EZ water, cell voltage restoration (-20 mV → -90 mV), and torsion spin fields. The temporal ordering of the PLL follows a nested harmonic cascade (Faixat), and the entire process is described as a holographic, toroidal, string‑resonant actualisation of potentialities. The paper concludes with testable predictions, a longitudinal case study (the author), and two Addenda integrating Faixat’s work. The goal is a “Hybrid Civilization” where science and spirit are two faces of one conscious universe. -/- Keywords: Light body, cosmopsychism, dual‑aspect monism, quantum biology, bioelectricity, torsion fields, toroidal harmonics, string theory of evolution, Eastern esotericism, Western esotericism, Ogdoadic Synthesis -/- Acknowledgements: AI tools were used for language refinement and editing.

items.title: Show Your Face: Women's Rights as Casus Belli.
items.abstract: What drives humanitarian military intervention? This essay proposes that women's rights as casus belli is not a rational ethical argument but a libidinal one — and that this distinction changes everything. Introducing the concept of libidinal war, the essay argues that the structure of contemporary intervention reproduces an archaic logic in which women function not as subjects of liberation but as currency in an economy of conquest between male groups. The liberator's indifference to the actual death of the women he claims to free is not hypocrisy — it is structural. The dead woman has simply fallen out of the libidinal schema.
